about: Prerequisite map for G5 The changing economic world (brief docs/briefs/2026-11-15-script-four-topics.md, B1, 2026-11-19): every idea the three scripted lessons use, what each depends on (maths included), and where it is taught. Lessons run in syllabus order: g5-development, g5-nigeria, g5-uk-economy. Used when scripting: each script teaches or recalls an idea before it asks about it.

ideas.name: Mean, median, range, interquartile range, percentage
ideas.taught: KS3 maths; recalled in g5-development key point 1 (E88: range given for the interquartile range)

ideas.name: Per person (per head): a total shared equally
A rate: per 1,000 people (or births) each year
Development: quality of life getting better
Economic and social measures (GNI per head, life expectancy, infant mortality, birth and death rates, people per doctor, literacy, safe water, HDI) and their limitations
HICs, LICs, NEEs; World Bank income groups; the Brandt Line
Demographic Transition Model: five stages, linked to development
Causes of uneven development (physical, economic, historical) and consequences (disparities, international migration)
Strategies: investment, industrial development, tourism (Kenya), aid, intermediate technology, Fairtrade, debt relief, microfinance
Primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary sectors
ideas.taught: g5-nigeria key point 2; g5-uk-economy key point 2

ideas.name: Multiplier effect: one new business leads to more jobs and tax
TNCs: advantages and disadvantages for a host country
Types of aid: bilateral, multilateral, NGOs; impacts
Nigeria: location, importance, context, economy, trade, aid, environment, quality of life
Causes of UK economic change: deindustrialisation, globalisation, government policies
Post-industrial economy; science and business parks
Industry and the environment; Toyota at Burnaston
Rural change: growth (South Cambridgeshire) and decline (Outer Hebrides)
Road, rail, port and airport developments; the north–south divide and strategies
The UK's links: trade, culture, transport, electronic communication; EU and Commonwealth
